verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only the access-control slice of this story: scoped API tokens can be limited to specific resources and permission levels across Account, User or Zone groups, down to a single zone. Account-level tokens are also mentioned. Nothing in the pack documents managing Worker secrets or environment variables, centrally or otherwise. Missing for 10: secrets management, environment-variable configuration, team member roles/RBAC, centralized multi-project config management, independent corroboration.
